sentences.en: All Martha Stewart furniture collections include assortments of sofas, love seats, armchairs, chaise lounges and ottomans available in many choices of upholstery colors and fabrics.

sentences.en: Wine Country prides themselves on having gift baskets that include well thought out assortments of products and gift items, offered at an excellent value.

sentences.en: Gift baskets are available for as little as $25 up to their super baskets that include Champagne or large wine assortments for $125 to $225.
